name: ToggleButton
summary: A button that stays pressed: it flips a single on/off setting, such as bold in a toolbar, and shows the on state with its Selected colours. Use a switch for a setting that takes effect like a form field, and a checkbox inside forms.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: Controls the on state from outside; when given, defaultChecked is ignored and the caller flips it in onClick.

inputs.name: defaultChecked
inputs.description: The initial on state when the button controls itself.

inputs.name: isAccessible
inputs.description: Draws the on state as a brand fill on every appearance, which contrasts with rest far more than the default Selected tint.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: As button; while checked the icon shows its filled variant.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: As button; an uncontrolled toggle button also flips its checked state.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: As button: the box whose background, border and text change with the checked state.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: As button; filled while checked, regular otherwise.

variants.description: Checked: colorNeutralBackground1Selected fill, Stroke 1 border and Foreground 1 Selected text.
Checked: colorBrandBackgroundSelected fill, a transparent border and on-brand text.
Checked: colorTransparentBackgroundSelected (transparent) fill with a strokeWidthThicker Stroke 1 border; the thick border is the on signal.
Checked: colorSubtleBackgroundSelected fill, transparent border, colorNeutralForeground2Selected text, and the icon in colorNeutralForeground2BrandSelected.
Checked: colorTransparentBackgroundSelected fill and colorNeutralForeground2BrandSelected text and icon.

isAccessible: checked is colorBrandBackground with on-brand text and a transparent border on every appearance, stepping to BrandBackgroundHover and Pressed; outline keeps a thin border, primary adds a 1px on-brand inner outline, and subtle's hovered icon stays on-brand.

layout.text: Geometry, padding, minimum widths, icon sizes and text are as button: the toggle's styles are merged ahead of the button's hook, which applies them all.

Checked sets the border width to strokeWidthThin explicitly; checked outline widens it to strokeWidthThicker (3px) inside the same border box, so the outer size does not change and the content area shrinks by 2px a side. isAccessible outline returns it to strokeWidthThin.

isAccessible primary draws a strokeWidthThin colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand outline inset by strokeWidthThicker, an inner ring that marks it on; while focus-visible the ring is inset by strokeWidthThickest instead, clearing the focus ring.

states.text: Unchecked rest, hover, pressed and disabled are exactly as button.
Checked swaps the appearance's rest colours for its Selected tokens (see variants) and shows the filled icon.

Checked and hovered reads the ordinary Hover tokens, not a selected-hover twin: secondary Background 1, Stroke 1 and Foreground 1 Hover; primary BrandBackgroundHover; outline and transparent TransparentBackgroundHover (transparent's text Foreground2BrandHover); subtle SubtleBackgroundHover with Foreground2Hover. The transition is as button.
Checked and pressed (pointer down, or active while focus-visible) reads the ordinary Pressed tokens per appearance, as hover does with Hover.
As button (the inset colorStrokeFocus2 ring), except checked outline, whose focused border stays colorNeutralStroke1 instead of turning colorStrokeFocus2.

Disabled overrides checked: Background, Stroke and Foreground Disabled on secondary and outline, a transparent border on primary, and a transparent background on subtle and transparent, whose hover and press still step to TransparentBackgroundHover and Pressed.

behaviour.text: Click, Enter or Space flips checked (uncontrolled) or runs onClick for the caller to flip it (controlled).
While checked the icon shows its filled variant regardless of hover.
Activation, focus visibility, disabledFocusable and the colour transition are as button.

semantics: an icon-only toggle needs an aria-label that names the setting, not the state

notes.text: Default checked colours are low-contrast against rest (Background1Selected is a light grey; outline, transparent and primary change only a border width, a text colour or one brand step). isAccessible exists to fix this; prefer it wherever the on state must be obvious.
Hovering or pressing a checked button reads the same Hover and Pressed tokens as an unchecked one, so on and off look identical under the pointer.
Disabled subtle and transparent toggles still tint to colorTransparentBackgroundHover and Pressed on hover and press, unlike the disabled button, which stays transparent.
The high-contrast focus border is a literal 1px HighlightText; everything else reads tokens.

Under forced colours a checked toggle is Highlight with HighlightText text and a Highlight border, inverting to HighlightText background and Highlight text on hover and press; focus is a 1px HighlightText border with a Highlight outline. Primary drops button's primary high-contrast look and is ButtonFace, ButtonBorder and ButtonText at rest, GrayText when disabled. The icon keeps forced colour adjustment on.
